post.description:
Upload media files for a specific post and update its status to READY.

This endpoint handles media file uploads for posts using the PostMedia table.
- Single file uploads for non-carousel content types
- Multiple file uploads for carousel content types
- Files are saved to the static_files/posts/media directory
- PostMedia entries are created for each uploaded file
- Post status is automatically changed to READY

Args:
    post_id (int): The unique identifier of the post to upload media for
    files (List[UploadFile]): The media files to upload
    db (AsyncSession): Database session dependency

Returns:
    PostResponse: The updated post data with new media entries and READY status
    
Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if the post is not found
    HTTPException: 400 if invalid file type or file count mismatch
    HTTPException: 500 if file upload fails

put.description:
Replace existing media file for a specific post.

This endpoint replaces the existing media file for a post. When media is replaced:
- The old file is deleted from the filesystem
- The new file is saved to the static_files/posts/media directory
- The post's media_url is updated with the relative path (without base URL)
- The post's content_type is auto-updated based on the new file type
- The post status remains unchanged (unless it's DRAFT, then it becomes READY)

Args:
    post_id (int): The unique identifier of the post to replace media for
    file (UploadFile): The new media file to upload (image, video, etc.)
    db (AsyncSession): Database session dependency

Returns:
    PostResponse: The updated post data with the new media_url and updated content_type
    
Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if the post is not found
    HTTPException: 400 if the post doesn't have existing media or invalid file type
    HTTPException: 500 if file upload fails

delete.description:
Delete media file for a specific post and reset status to DRAFT.

This endpoint removes the media file from a post and resets its status to DRAFT.
The media file will be physically deleted from the filesystem.

Args:
    post_id (int): The unique identifier of the post to delete media from
    db (AsyncSession): Database session dependency

Returns:
    PostResponse: The updated post data with media_url set to None and status DRAFT
    
Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if the post is not found
    HTTPException: 400 if the post doesn't have media
    HTTPException: 500 if file deletion fails

post.description:
Handle Meta webhook events.

This endpoint receives POST requests from Meta when events occur on pages
or Instagram accounts connected to the app.

Facebook Page Events (object: "page"):
- New comments on posts ✅ (SUPPORTED - "feed" field)
- Likes on posts ✅ (SUPPORTED - "feed" field)
- Shares of posts ✅ (SUPPORTED - "feed" field, ensure shares are included in Meta App Dashboard)
- New posts ✅ (SUPPORTED - "feed" field)
- Engagement insights ✅ (SUPPORTED - "pages_read_engagement" field)
  * Triggers when engagement metrics (likes, comments, shares) change
  * Provides real-time updates for post engagement

Instagram Events (object: "instagram"):
- Comments on posts ✅ (SUPPORTED - subscribe to "comments" field)
- Mentions ✅ (SUPPORTED - subscribe to "mentions" field)
- Story insights ✅ (SUPPORTED - subscribe to "story_insights" field)
- Messages ✅ (SUPPORTED - subscribe to "messages" field)
- Live comments ✅ (SUPPORTED - subscribe to "live_comments" field)
- Insights updates ✅ (SUPPORTED - "instagram_manage_insights" field, if Meta sends them)

NOT SUPPORTED VIA WEBHOOKS (must use polling):
- Instagram likes ❌ (Instagram does NOT send webhooks for likes)
- Instagram shares ❌ (Instagram does NOT send webhooks for shares)
- Instagram saves ❌ (Instagram does NOT send webhooks for saves)

NOTE: A background polling service runs every 10 minutes to fetch Instagram likes/shares/saves
and supplement Facebook insights to ensure comprehensive coverage.

Args:
    request: FastAPI request object containing the webhook payload
    db: Database session

Returns:
    JSON response confirming receipt of the webhook
